lines.speaker: WIEGERT
lines.text: When he stabbed her, did she scream or what?

lines.speaker: WIEGERT
lines.text: How many times did he stab her?

lines.speaker: WIEGERT
lines.text: We know he did something else to her, what else did he do to her?

lines.speaker: WIEGERT
lines.text: How did he do that? Tell me how he did it.

lines.speaker: WIEGERT
lines.text: Was he on top of her?

lines.speaker: WIEGERT
lines.text: And did he choke her until what, did she go unconscious, what, tell me.

lines.speaker: WIEGERT
lines.text: Yeah. Did she fall asleep, go unconscious?

lines.speaker: WIEGERT
lines.text: Is that before of after he stabbed her?

lines.speaker: WIEGERT
lines.text: So he stabs her, show me what he does. Just demonstrate for me.
